description.narrative: The project aims to strengthen inclusive, rights-based social protection in Jigawa State by ensuring marginalized groups, such as women, youth, persons with disabilities, and older persons are fully involved in the design, implementation, and monitoring of social protection programmes. It will build the capacity of government duty bearers and community representatives, improve inclusive data collection, and raise awareness on human rights, gender equality, and inclusion. The project will empower communities, especially women, PWDs, and older persons to engage in advocacy and influence policy decisions. Expected outcomes include updated and inclusive social registries, fairer programme delivery, stronger civil society participation, and policy reforms driven through multi-level advocacy and citizen oversight.
